parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: VbrInstanceOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the VBR instance.

parameters.name: VbrInstanceRegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VBR instance.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to obtain region IDs.
